sections.Profile:
Orbit 1, released by Australian manufacturer A. Hankin & Co. in 1978, is a solid-state pinball machine with a space exploration theme.

- Manufacturer: A. Hankin & Co.
- Years made: 1978–1981
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Space, Original Theme, 1970s, Solid State
